title: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 5.7% After Oracle AI Deal And Revenue Outlook Boost - What's Changed
title_zh: Oracle AI 交易和收入前景提升后，Bloom Energy (BE) 上涨 5.7% - 发生了什么变化
summary: In early 2026, Bloom Energy reported a very strong first quarter with revenue more than doubling year over year, raised its 2026 revenue outlook to US$3.40–US$3.80 billion, and expanded its Oracle agreement to supply up to 2.8 gigawatts of fuel cell capacity for AI data center...
summary_zh: 2026 年初，Bloom Energy 公布了非常强劲的第一季度业绩，收入同比增长了一倍以上，将 2026 年收入预期上调至 3.40 美元至 38 亿美元，并扩大了与 Oracle 的协议，为 AI 数据中心提供高达 2.8 吉瓦的燃料电池容量……

title: Magnum Ice Cream shares surge on report of PE buyout interest
title_zh: PE 收购兴趣报道导致 Magnum 冰淇淋股价飙升
summary: Investing.com -- Magnum Ice Cream Nv (NYSE:MICC) shares jumped 10.9% in U.S. premarket trading and 10.5% in European markets on Friday following reports of potential private equity interest.
summary_zh: Investing.com——周五，在有关潜在私募股权投资的报道之后，Magnum Ice Cream Nv (NYSE:MICC) 股价在美国盘前交易中上涨 10.9%，在欧洲市场上涨 10.5%。

title: The PE Paradox: Volatility Fuels New Deals as Old Assets Sit Frozen in Portfolios
title_zh: 私募股权悖论：旧资产在投资组合中冻结，波动性助长新交易
summary: Glinting investment opportunities abound, private-equity firms say—but the industry also faces an exit bottleneck of over $3 trillion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司表示，闪闪发光的投资机会比比皆是，但该行业也面临着超过 3 万亿美元的退出瓶颈。
